story_text: As a user, I want to receive an error when I try to reset the password with an unregistered email so that I know the email is not in the system.

positive.title: Display error message when password reset is requested with an unregistered email
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request.
positive.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered.

positive.title: Display consistent error message for different unregistered email inputs during password reset
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter various unregistered email addresses (e.g., invalid format, non-existent domain).
3. Submit the password reset request for each input.
positive.expected_result: The system should display a consistent error message indicating that the email is not registered for all unregistered email inputs.

negative.title: Incorrect error message displayed for unregistered email during password reset
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request.
negative.expected_result: The system should display an incorrect error message indicating that the email is not registered.

negative.title: No error message displayed when password reset is requested with an unregistered email
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request.
negative.expected_result: The system should not display any error message, leaving the user unaware that the email is not registered.

negative.title: Error message does not disappear after entering valid email during password reset
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request.
4. Enter a registered email address.
5. Submit the password reset request again.
negative.expected_result: The system should continue to display the error message from the previous unregistered email attempt, even after entering a valid registered email.

negative.title: Error message displayed for registered email during password reset
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request.
negative.expected_result: The system should incorrectly display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, even though it is.

edge.title: Reset password with unregistered email containing uppercase characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address with uppercase characters (e.g., JOHN@EXAMPLE.COM).
3. Submit the password reset request.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, regardless of the case sensitivity of the email input.

edge.title: Reset password with unregistered email containing special characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address with special characters (e.g., john+test@example.com).
3. Submit the password reset request.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, regardless of the presence of special characters in the email input.

edge.title: Reset password with unregistered email submitted multiple times rapidly
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request multiple times in quick succession.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, even if the request is submitted multiple times in quick succession.

edge.title: Reset password with unregistered email while offline
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request while the device is offline.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, even while offline. Alternatively, the system may display a message indicating that the request cannot be processed due to lack of connectivity, but should not indicate that the email is registered.

edge.title: Reset password with unregistered email and observe system's response under high server load
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address.
3. Submit the password reset request while the server is under high load.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, even under high server load.

edge.title: Reset password with unregistered email after previous successful reset attempt
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address and successfully reset the password.
3. After the successful reset, enter an unregistered email address.
4. Submit the password reset request.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the email is not registered, even after a previous successful reset attempt.
